title: Wings live: Pavillon, Montreux | 1972
content:
Wings performed at the Pavillon in Montreux, Switzerland, on 22 July 1972.

It was the eighth night of the Wings Over Europe Tour, which opened in Ollioules, France, on 9 July. They were Paul McCartney’s first European concerts since 1966.

This was the end of the first leg of the tour, which resumed in Copenhagen on 1 August. In the interim Paul and Linda McCartney flew to New York, where on 26 July they watched The Rolling Stones at Madison Square Garden.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Henry McCullough on guitar and vocals; and Denny Seiwell on drums.
